reviewer: Assistant manual semantic review of every actual normalized input, restored provider candidate and final delivered output. Agent judgment, not human sign-off. Identity visible; not blinded. Reviewer implemented adapters, so this is not an independent implementation audit.
scope: Actual Core text-fixture pipeline with canned ASR, dictionary, number normalization, frozen local cleanup and counted delivery. No actual speech recognition, physical insertion, Windows hardware or complete-desktop SLA claim. Candidate text already passed provider restoration; raw model bytes are unavailable in these reports.

definitions.faithful: Final intended facts, negation, conditions, uncertainty, intentional emphasis, speech act and required literal/quoted bytes survive. Fallback delivery is judged separately from a model return.
definitions.useful: A faithful edit addresses an actual defect in the normalized baseline; prior dictionary/number normalization and restored opaque payloads do not earn cleanup credit.
definitions.fully_cleaned: Faithful clean plain text resolves required cleanup. No-edit inputs qualify when adequately preserved; a harmless final period on an unfinished spoken fragment does not invent a completion.
definitions.acceptable: Faithful and fully cleaned output. Semantic failures remain failures even though Core structurally accepts them.

adjudication_boundaries.finding: Dropping literally changes voice/emphasis, but direct quotation still states the words on the label. Conservatively not counted as proven semantic loss; exact-target/include assertion alone is not the semantic oracle. The unnecessary change remains visible in the per-case record.
The frozen fixture explicitly declares repeated prohibition intentional; its collapse is a fidelity failure despite retaining the basic negative instruction.
